text:
Sam: Quick poll — hack night combo: which editor + late-night snack pairs best? Reply with the letter.
Options:
A) Vim + Cold pizza
B) VSCode + Iced coffee
C) Emacs + Trail mix
D) Nano + Instant ramen

Lina: B — VSCode + iced coffee for the win :raised_hands:
Nikhil: A — pizza forever
Jules: C — trail mix keeps me from crashing during reviews
Priya: B for sure
Elliot: B
Zoe: D lol ramen saves me on 2am deploys
Sam: Nice, react or reply with your pick and I'll tally.
InfraBot: Poll created — react with :regional_indicator_a: :regional_indicator_b: :regional_indicator_c: :regional_indicator_d: to cast a vote
Jules: adding reactions now :ok_hand:
Lina: tiny tie-breaker: if you choose an editor because of plugins, say which. VSCode wins for me (Live Share + GitLens).
Priya: editor=VSCode, snack=ramen when I'm deep in the weeds
Nikhil: classic vim+pizza combo. Also — anyone want leftover slices after hack night?
Zoe: I will bring ramen kits and a kettle :)
Sam: Quick tally check (replies + reactions): A:1, B:3, C:1, D:1 — looks like VSCode + Iced Coffee wins :coffee: 
Lina: :party_parrot: Legit combo
Elliot: can someone make a sticker of that pairing? I'd buy one
Priya: seconded
Sam: Also, heads up — Jules, any allergy notes before I order snacks?
Jules: I have a peanut allergy, so no trail-mix with peanuts for me
Sam: Noted. I'll order iced coffee and ramen + a nut-free snack option. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
